description: Validator for the stir_shaken callflow data object. The action branches on the inbound STIR/SHAKEN verdict, to the child passed, failed or none, and takes no data of its own: the prefix put on the caller id name of a failed call is cid_name_prefix_failed in system_config/stir

skip_module.description: When set to true this callflow action is skipped, advancing to the wildcard branch (if any)
